items.class: Grade 2 (26 students) 二年級（26 人）
items.detail_en: Period 2. A reading lesson for young learners: three English sentences (Open the book! / I can read! / Books open doors!), actions, counting, and Dom's SDG 4 animation. Classroom to be confirmed.
items.detail_zh: 第二大節。給低年級的閱讀課：三句英文（Open the book! / I can read! / Books open doors!）、肢體動作、數一數，以及 Dom 的 SDG 4 動畫。上課地點待確認。

items.class: Grade 1 (18 students) 一年級（18 人）
items.detail_en: Period 3. The same lesson as Grade 2. Classroom to be confirmed.
items.detail_zh: 第三大節。與二年級同一套課程。上課地點待確認。

items.detail_en: Period 4. Two questions: 1) Why did you choose to lead a school? What is your philosophy of education? 2) Why do international connections and English learning matter so much for students?
items.detail_zh: 第四大節。兩個問題：一、為何要擔任校長（教育理念）？二、為何推國際連結與英語教育對學生而言很重要？
items.note_en: For the Voices in Education series.
items.note_zh: 收錄於「教育之聲」專訪系列。

footnote_en: The school asked for a lesson about reading. Both classes use the same deck, built for first and second graders. The visit ends around 12:00 p.m., after the interview.
footnote_zh: 學校希望主題與閱讀有關。兩班用同一套簡報，依一、二年級的程度設計。校長採訪結束、約 12:00 離開。
